text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah! What an incredible race!!
Golshi and Earth, I am totally stanning them~!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth really is strong...! 
Could this be the start of the Earth generation...!?
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa... Haa...――

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Fufufu...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Bennnnnnissimo!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"To think it could be this intense...! A session with the Umamusume at the very center of the era...!
The melody coursing through my entire body makes my blood boil...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(I feel like I'm going crazy!
It's as if the entire world is ringing with sounds of pure ecstasy—)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ――I get ya.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Man...
After pulling an all-nighter, pork miso soup and rice balls really hit the spot.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Golshi-san—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
That certainly does look... very delicious.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Next time, let's talk about
the endless possibilities of morning ramen.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't you forget the oolong tea,
Sounds of Earth!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...That free melody is forever etched in my heart.
Grazie, Golshi-san...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Now then—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Shion-san.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: That was a powerful, straightforward run—so true to who you are.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To have been able to harmonize our sounds today...
I am deeply happy from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Grazie, Win Variation-san.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...My running isn't anything worthy of praise.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Because I haven't gained anything yet.
I haven't... become the main character yet."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Even if you
aren't the protagonist just yet.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Even if you didn't get the result you desired.
Even if you couldn't win it all—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to be the star, never giving up and continuing to run...
Your figure, your heart—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Nobler and more beautiful than anything else.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Sometimes, even more than the leading role.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Shion-san.
Listen closely.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It's coming from that direction.
...I'm sure you can hear it.

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Variatiooon!!
You looked so cool today too!!
You're number one!!

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You were amaziiing!!
I'll be cheering you on forever and everrr!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...That's right...――
Back then, too...――
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "Ngh... guhhh...!!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "Dammit... Dammit all...!!!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "I will... until the very end... ngh...!!"

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan A
text_block_list.text: "VARIATIOOOOONNN!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"You gave it everything you had!
Right till the very end! Without ever giving up!
You were so amazingly cool!"

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan D
text_block_list.text:
""I was watching the whole time!!
From start to finish, you were amazing!!
You're number one!!""

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Back then... I was just so frustrated...
My mind was completely overwhelmed by it...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I wasn't able to truly take in the warmth of the words they gave me at all, ssu.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Still...—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I feel like...
I can hear things really well, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
We truly connected, I'm sure of it.
Deeply, through this race—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
They know very well
what is strongest and most beautiful about Shion-san.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Please, I hope you won't
forget that love.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ............Yeah, pretty much.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"They saw my whole journey... all the results...
and they're still cheering for me anyway—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ......Someday, I want to live up to those expectations.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"By becoming the true, bona fide star of the show...
To everyone who loves me—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Brava!!
You truly are noble and beautiful...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: 'Sup...
"...After giving it his all in the Tenno Sho (Spring), Sounds of Earth returned to the waiting room and—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
choice_data_list: Earth, you should take a break soon...!

text_block_list.text:
She continued playing, as if venting
something deep inside her.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me, Direttore.
The music just wouldn't stop, you see."
choice_data_list: That just goes to show what an amazing race it was.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me, Direttrice.
The music just wouldn't stop, you see."
choice_data_list: That just goes to show what an amazing race it was.

text_block_list.text: —Indeed, even my own hands were sweating with excitement.
Even now, looking back on the fierce battles between Sounds of Earth and those seasoned Umamusume stirs up thrilling excitement...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: A depth and diversity unlike anything seen during the Classic year. The raw intensity of the hopes carried by the spectators—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
All of it showed.
That this was the music of a Senior Class GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...And with that, a new desire awoke within me.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I want to involve other generations far more broadly...
And on a stage that strengthens the audience's passions even further, deliver the ultimate session of this era!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And the races themselves... the racing world itself...!
I want to make all of it, every bit of it, way more fun!!
I want to hype it up! I want to move people's hearts!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"For that sake, too...
I want you to aim for it with me, please—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup, and the Arima Kinen!!

The Japan Cup is an international invitational GⅠ race
held at Tokyo Racecourse over 2400 meters on turf.
It goes without saying that this is a pinnacle race where the nation's top Umamusume and overseas elites clash fiercely.
Meanwhile, the Arima Kinen is a Grand Prix race held at Nakayama Racecourse.
A stage marking the culmination of the year, where supreme Umamusume bearing the dreams of racing fans gather.

Sounds of Earth should be able to compete in either race.
She proved today that she has more than enough ability for it...!
choice_data_list: Let's aim for those two supreme stages!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Molto bene!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What an unwavering radiance...!!
That's what makes you my Trainer...!
And so, on that day, we tentatively decided to set our sights on the Japan Cup and the Arima Kinen...!

A few days later.
When I set up a meeting to redraw our future roadmap—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"—There's something I want to do
as we aim for the Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Didn't I tell you before?
That I want to involve other generations more broadly.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Specifically, I'd like to try getting the younger generation of Umamusume involved too.
choice_data_list: I see, so you meant that one...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I believe that by doing so, we could create
a session even more colorful than the Tenno Sho (Spring)—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Direttore?
...Did I spread myself too thin, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Direttrice?
...Did I spread myself too thin, perhaps?
Everything Sounds of Earth has done to build excitement for the races up until now was completely right.

And the more exciting and fun the race gets,
the better her own performance becomes.

In other words—
I have absolutely no reason
to stop her from doing what she wants.
choice_data_list: I'd love to see that jam session too!
I want to see that session too!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie, Trainer.
Then it's settled. Let us actively pursue
the possibility of running alongside them...!
choice_data_list: Then, mind if I make a suggestion too?
Then may I make a suggestion as well?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's hear it.

"The Sapporo Kinen is a GII turf race over 2000m,
held at Sapporo Racecourse in the summer."

Because it attracts a star-studded lineup of runners virtually every year,
it is sometimes called the 'Super GⅡ'.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I see! As the culmination of the summer, you'll be testing your skills there ahead of the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I am all for it.
Let us proceed with that plan...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm looking forward to both summer and autumn...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Let us aim for it.
The ultimate music that transcends generations...!

And so, harboring grand ambitions,
we get to work alongside Sounds of Earth.
First up in the summer: the Sapporo Kinen!!
